title: The Manuscript Desk
prompt: Design a fictional webapp-workspace example for this task: A quiet place to draft, followed by a deliberate editing pass. A wide manuscript leads; revision guidance moves into a labelled disclosure below the editor, with chapter context across the top. Preserve the supplied data, keyboard controls, recovery actions and local-only behavior. Use Libre Baskerville and a #F5F0E6 page with #303E67 accents.
